definitions.gloss: others; the rest; miscellaneous; et cetera

{本|ほん}や⟦ノート→ノート：00738_nooto⟧、その{他|た}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{文房具|ぶんぼうぐ}→文房具：12869_bunbougu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}った→買う：00489_kau⟧。

examples.english: Transportation costs, food expenses, and various other expenses were incurred.

notes:
A very common expression meaning "others" or "the rest," used to refer to remaining items in a category. Often appears in lists, forms, and menus as a catch-all category.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- その{他|た}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ + noun: other (noun), the remaining (noun)
- その{他|た}もろもろ: various other things
- その{他|た}いろいろ: and various others

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- その{他|た}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{費用|ひよう}→費用：03588_hiyou⟧: other expenses
- その{他|た}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{条件|じょうけん}→条件：03285_jouken⟧: other conditions
- その{他|た}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{事項|じこう}→事項：11469_jikou⟧: other matters
- その{他|た}⟦{大勢|おおぜい}→大勢：02850_oozei⟧: the masses, the rest of the crowd

USAGE:
Often written as その{他|た} or simply その{他|ほか} (read as ⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧ほか), which is a near-synonym. The ⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧た reading is more formal and commonly appears in written documents, forms, and official categories, while ⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧ほか is more conversational.
